europe_now.title: Germany Investigates Substation Sabotage and Diplomatic Fallout
europe_now.summary: German authorities are investigating suspected power substation sabotage while Russia has summoned a German envoy amid escalating tensions. The EU and NATO have vowed to step up pressure on Russia following the security incidents.

sources.headline: Germany investigates suspected power substation sabotage, Russia summons German envoy
EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany

europe_now.title: Slovenian Parliament Lifts Former Prime Minister's Immunity
europe_now.summary: The Slovenian parliament has voted to lift the parliamentary immunity of former Prime Minister Robert Golob. This decision clears the way for ongoing police investigations into alleged political meddling.

sources.headline: Slovenian parliament lifts former PM Golob’s immunity in police-meddling probe

top_stories.title: Escalating Security Tensions and Sabotage Investigations in Germany
top_stories.summary: German authorities are actively investigating a suspected power substation sabotage incident. In response to recent security breaches, international allies including the EU and NATO have pledged increased pressure against external threats.

sources.headline: Germany investigates suspected power substation sabotage, Russia summons German envoy
EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany

top_stories.title: Slovenian Political Immunity Investigation
top_stories.summary: The Slovenian parliament has officially lifted the immunity protecting former Prime Minister Robert Golob. The legislative action directly supports law enforcement officers conducting an ongoing probe into police meddling allegations.

sources.headline: Slovenian parliament lifts former PM Golob’s immunity in police-meddling probe
